professional_summary: Backend engineer with 9 years building and running distributed systems for logistics and payments. Currently at Northwind Logistics, where I own the shipment tracking platform that serves 4,000 requests per second and cut median latency from 480ms to 90ms. Before that, 4 years at Kestrel Payments on the ledger team, where I led the migration from a monolith to 6 services with zero downtime. Comfortable owning a system end to end: schema design, deploys, on-call, and the postmortem afterwards.

work_history.title: Senior Backend Engineer
highlights: Own the shipment tracking platform: 4,000 req/s peak, 99.97% availability over the last 12 months
Cut median API latency from 480ms to 90ms by replacing per-request joins with a materialized read model
Introduced trunk-based development and a 12-minute CI pipeline; deploy frequency went from weekly to 14 per day
Mentored 3 engineers through their first on-call rotation

work_history.title: Backend Engineer, Ledger

Built the double-entry ledger that reconciles 2.1M transactions per day
Reduced end-of-month close from 3 days to 4 hours by making reconciliation incremental
